items.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23

ctx.x: At that time they had a wave of blues singers coming to New Orleans. Yeah. Ida Cox, you remember? Yeah. Oh, yeah. She died right there in Chicago, I believe. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Hmm. Oh, yeah. And, uh, I know, of course you know, I know Louis.
Armstrong. Yeah. Yeah. With friends. Yeah, he played together with Udall Wilson for some time. Yeah. Yeah.

And Zutty Zingal. Yeah. Yeah. Zutty. Oh, yeah. Zutty's still there in New York. Yeah, I know. Danny's in New Orleans. Danny back, I met him in New Orleans some days ago. Yeah. Yeah. He was in New York, but he's back down there in New Orleans now. Yeah. Yeah.
